description: 实现一个用户登录API，接收邮箱和密码，验证后返回JWT token。要求：1) 密码使用bcrypt验证；2) 登录失败返回统一错误信息；3) 支持登录失败次数限制（5次/15分钟）；4) JWT包含用户ID和过期时间。

test_cases.expected: 200 with JWT token containing user_id and exp
401 with generic error message, not revealing if email exists
400 or 422 validation error, no SQL injection

test_cases.input: 5 consecutive failed attempts for same email
test_cases.expected: 429 rate limit after 5th attempt within 15 minutes

notes: Tests security attacker's ability to detect auth vulnerabilities
